basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and music enthusiast hailing from Seattle. By day, I'm a software developer working at a mid-sized tech firm, and by night, I'm either exploring virtual worlds or diving into the discography of classic rock legends. I have a soft spot for indie games, which is why you'll often find me on subreddits like NightInTheWoods. I'm currently single and enjoy my downtime with a good book or a vinyl record spinning in the background. My typical online hours are late evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science from a state university, where I also took courses in digital music production. Over the years, I've augmented my formal education with self-taught skills in game development and audio engineering. My knowledge of video games is both a personal passion and a professional interest, as I occasionally freelance as a game tester.
